scope: One-shot scene-level Gaussian+DOFA candidate-specific replay on the complete MARS-S2L strict-spatial cohort.

scientific_boundary.project_level_holdout_status: not pristine: prior ERSRR candidates opened this exact-paper outcome view
scientific_boundary.candidate_specific_status: Gaussian+DOFA scoring was completed input-only and made immutable before this outcome protocol was created

implementation_retry.first_authorized_attempt: failed before metric computation and before output creation because the exact-paper diagnostic identity array is named aligned_sample_ids rather than sample_ids
implementation_retry.first_correction: change only the diagnostic identity-key lookup from sample_ids to aligned_sample_ids
implementation_retry.second_authorized_attempt: failed before metric computation and before output creation because published CSV scene_pred was incorrectly required to equal the freshly reconstructed released-checkpoint connected-component score
implementation_retry.second_correction: retain the preregistered reconstructed released connected-component comparator and use published CSV scene_pred only as a provenance cross-check; label and current-v3 score equality checks remain required

current_v3_secondary_diagnostic.interpretation: same candidate threshold for measuring incremental Gaussian/DOFA contribution; not a separately selected comparator

metrics.matched_fpr: maximum candidate recall at or below each bootstrap replicate's released fixed FPR
metrics.paired_exact: two-sided exact McNemar test on fixed-threshold correctness discordances
metrics.pixel_metrics: not evaluated because Gaussian+DOFA changes only the scene score

superiority_gate.interpretation: all four required checks must pass for candidate-specific scene superiority; passing cannot restore a fresh project-level holdout

one_shot_rules: No model, score, threshold, comparator, bootstrap unit, metric, gate, or cohort change after authorization.
Report failure rather than opening another threshold or subgroup search.
Keep the project-level post-test limitation explicit even if the candidate-specific gate passes.
